name: SikaControl-3122 WT
paste:
SIKACONTROL®-3122 WT: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaControl®-3122 WT, May 2026, Version 05.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/v/sikacontrol-3122wt.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaControl®-3122 WT where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (May 2026, Version 05.02).
1.2 Product description. SikaControl®-3122 WT is a waterproofing liquid admixture having both integral crystalline capillary and hydrophobic pore-blocking functions. It is designed for use in above- and below-grade applications. SikaControl®-3122 WT consists of various active, proprietary chemicals. These active chemicals react with the by-products of cement hydration to cause a reaction, which generates an insoluble crystalline deposit throughout the pores and capillary tracts of the concrete. Thus, the concrete with SikaControl®-3122 WT reduces water permeability. This product also has a self-healing property in the presence of moisture and can help wIth crack healing.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. SikaControl®-3122 WT can be used in all structural concrete that is constantly or intermittently in contact with water such as sea walls, tunnels, basements, structural and pre-cast concrete. SikaControl®-3122 WT can also be used as crystalline waterproofing admixture for cement mortars and plasters. SikaControl®-3122 WT can be used to enhance the waterproofing properties of structures such as:
    - Building basement and foundations
    - Sewage and water treatment plants
    - Dams
    - Tunnel and subway systems
    - Water reservoirs
    - Concrete pipes
    - Parking structures
    - Pre-cast, cast-in-place and shotcrete applications
    - Swimming pools
    - Retaining walls and sea defense walls
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaControl®-3122 WT
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Unique waterproofing admixture combining crystalline and hydrophobic pore-blocking ingredients
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports. SikaControl®-3122 WT is categorized as PRAH within ACI 212.3R-10 “Report on Chemical Admixtures for concrete” (Permeability reducing admixtures). SikaControl®-3122 WT meets the requirements of AS1478.1-2000 for Special Purpose Admixture Type (SN).
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS1478.1-2000: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Certificates And Test Reports (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Liquid product facilitates accurate measurement and recording of addition through existing concrete batch plant dispensing system
    - Reduces concrete permeability
    - Allows concrete to breathe
    - Non-toxic
    - Becomes an integral part of the concrete
    - Reduces penetration of water and other liquids under pressure
    - Can seal hairline cracks up to 0.5 mm
    - Protects against sewage and industrial wastes
    - Added to the concrete at time of batching and therefore, is not subject to climatic restraints
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Active chemicals compound.
    - Appearance and colour: Clear to yellow liquid
    - Density: ~1.05 kg/l (at 25°C)
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Total chloride ion content: < 100 mg/l
2.7 Concreting guidance. Points to remember when producing waterproof concrete:
    - Ensure water / cement ratio is less than 0.5
    - Addition of water reducing admixture such as SikaPlast® or Sika® ViscoCrete® range is advised to achieve minimum water/cement ratio.
    - Good concrete practice standards regarding mixing, placing and curing.
    - Use Sika® Antisol® products as a curing agent or apply wet hessian.
2.8 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Bulk deliveries; 1000 liter IBC
    - Shelf life: 12 months from date of production if stored properly
    - Storage conditions: Store in undamaged, unopened, original sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +35 °C.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (May 2026, Version 05.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (May 2026, Version 05.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Recommended dosage: 1–2.5 % by weight of binder. Dosage may vary depending on the mix design, raw materials and concrete requirements.
4.3 Compatibility. SikaControl®-3122 WT is suitable for mixes containing all types of cement and supplementary cementitious materials such as Microsilica (Silica Fume), Fly Ash (PFA), GGBS (Ground Granulated Blast Furnace Slag) and all Sika Concrete admixtures. Field trials must be conducted to establish the required performance when combining SikaControl®-3122 WT with the above products or other admixtures.
4.4 Dispensing. SikaControl®-3122 WT should be added within the recommended dosage. It may be batched in either a central or truck mixer. Provide at least 5 minutes of mixing after the addition of SikaControl®- 3122 WT admixture to ensure thorough and uniform distribution of the admixture in the concrete mixture.
4.5 Limitations and important considerations.
    - SikaControl®-3122 WT will neither initiate nor promote corrosion of reinforcing steel embedded in concrete, prestressed concrete or concrete placed on galvanized steel floor and roof systems.
    - Neither calcium chloride nor any calcium chloride based ingredients are used in the manufacture of SikaControl®-3122 WT. In all concrete application, SikaControl®-3122 WT will conform to the most stringent or minimum chloride ion limits currently suggested by construction industry standards and practices.
    - SikaControl®-3122 WT has minor or no effect on workability of concrete. Prior site trials are advised to assess the effect and any increase or decrease in the workability can be adjusted by adjusting the admixture dosage or amount of water in use.
    - It is strongly recommended that concrete should be properly cured particularly in hot, windy and dry climates.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (May 2026, Version 05.02) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaControl®-3122 WT, May 2026, Version 05.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/v/sikacontrol-3122wt.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaControl®-3122 WT, version 06/09/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/q/sds-sikacontrol-3122wt.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
